references.positiveOrNegativeAssertionBoundary: First pass real app Maker preview → distinct Ops endorsement → Owner approval and a successful compensation gate, then acquire RESTORE lease. Change only synthetic published Gate status to REVOKED or remove the exact object while preserving a valid adjacent native-value shape. The actual app open RESTORE fails SQLSTATE MO092 with COMPENSATION_GATE_SCOPE_ABSENT; no RESTORE attempt is inserted, and exact candidate/compensation approval JSON and production=false remain unchanged. This is actual gate/attempt refusal, not schema early rejection or production-flag-only denial.
